# Side A 0.5.39
- Show terminal reaches sessions in your own tmux: Side A brings forward the tab attached to the session, or opens one that attaches. - Automated runs (`claude -p` from launchd, cron or a script) say what started them instead of offering a terminal they don't have. - Autopilot can answer questions with their recommended options, and approve plans, after a minute. Permission requests are never answered this way. - Renaming a session renames the running Claude Code session too. - A request answered anywhere leaves the island, notifications and the phone at once. - New Mac logins join your accounts on their own, and Add Account no longer needs a name.
macOS 14 or later. Apple Silicon and Intel. Free.
